title: Previous Foreign visits — expenses incurred on chartered flights
note: The Prime Minister's Office publishes one chartered-flight amount per visit, not per leg. Amounts below are the published visit totals; per-leg figures in the tracker are distance-allocated estimates. 'IAF BBJ Aircraft' rows disclose no rupee amount. Visits after 2019 are not listed on that page, so visit expenditure for 2021–2026 comes from the MEA dataset in data/visit-costs-2021-2026.csv. Multi-country visits are summed; the per-country breakdown is kept under components.
additional_source: Ministry of External Affairs (MEA) visit-expenditure data
